title: Enchanted Book Filter
description: Filter enchanted book types with a new filter block, that pulls matching enchanted books from a hopper line above and outputs them below.
body:
**Mod Description**

Adds a two-slot filter block that pulls matching enchanted books from a hopper line above and outputs them below.
The block checks specific enchantments, meaning you can filter and sort enchanted books of all kinds, such as Mending, Protection IV, Unbreaking I, Unbreaking II, Unbreaking III.

**Crafting Recipe**

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d556d220bfa09eb0e77d20e9a1cd12b0c72b0a19.png)

Supports Mod Menu, has a Light and a Dark mode toggleable via the mod menu settings menu.

A huge thanks to [LIUKRAST](https://modrinth.com/user/LIUKRAST) for the texture/model and debugging assistance.
